title: Dream Travel Planner
description: AI-Powered Solo Trip Coach - Your private AI coach for solo travel empowerment. Overcome fears, build confidence, and finally book the trip you've always dreamed of.
longDescription:
**Dream Travel Planner**
Your private AI coach for solo travel empowerment.
Overcome fears, build confidence, and finally book the trip you've always dreamed of — one small step at a time.

Break through procrastination with daily micro-nudges tailored to your unique barriers (safety concerns, time scarcity, loneliness, confidence doubts, and more).

Track progress on a beautiful journey circle.
Reflect in a private journal that becomes your emotional proof of commitment.
Use on-device AI to get smarter, more personal encouragement as you go.

**Features:**

• 5-phase structured journey from Dream → Book → Go
• 50+ pre-written nudges (2–15 min each)
• Private journal with text & photo entries
• Full on-device AI personalization (no cloud, 100% private)
• 14-day free trial — no credit card required upfront

Whether you're craving adventure in Iceland, culture in Morocco, or peace in New Zealand — this is the companion that helps you stop waiting and start going.

Start your free trial today. Your dream trip is closer than you think.

legal.privacyPolicy:
**1. Introduction**

Welcome to Dream Travel Planner ("the App"). We are committed to protecting your privacy and empowering you to plan your solo adventures with complete peace of mind. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information.

**2. Our Privacy-First Approach**

Dream Travel Planner is built with privacy at its core. Our AI features run **100% on-device** — your personal reflections, fears, and travel dreams never leave your phone. We believe your journey to solo travel empowerment should be completely private.

**3. Information We Collect**

*Data You Provide:*
- Onboarding responses (travel preferences, barriers, destination dreams)
- Journal entries (text and photos)
- Progress data (nudge completions, phase advancement)
- Account information (email address if you create an account)

*Automatically Collected Data:*
- Device information (device type, operating system version)
- App usage analytics (features used, session duration)
- Crash reports and performance data

*HealthKit Data (Optional):*
- With your explicit permission, we may access activity and wellness data from Apple HealthKit to suggest optimal times for travel planning activities. This data is processed locally on your device and is never transmitted externally.

**4. How We Use Your Information**

We use your data to:
- Provide personalized AI coaching and nudge recommendations (processed on-device)
- Track your progress through the 5-phase journey
- Store your journal entries securely
- Improve app performance and fix bugs
- Process subscription payments (via Apple's StoreKit)

**5. On-Device AI Processing**

Our AI features are powered entirely on your device:
- All personalization happens locally using Apple's on-device ML frameworks
- Your journal entries, fears, and personal reflections are **never sent to external servers**
- No cloud AI services are used to process your personal content
- Your emotional journey remains completely private

**6. Data Storage and Security**

- Journal entries and progress data are stored locally on your device
- Data is encrypted using iOS standard encryption
- If you enable iCloud backup, your data may be included in your device backup (controlled by your iOS settings)
- You can export or delete all your data at any time from within the App

**7. Subscription and Payment Data**

- Subscription management is handled through Apple's StoreKit and RevenueCat
- We do not have access to your payment card details
- RevenueCat receives anonymized subscription status information to manage your access
- See RevenueCat's privacy policy for details on their data practices

**8. Data Sharing**

We do **NOT** sell your personal data. Ever.

We may share data only:
- With RevenueCat for subscription management (anonymized identifiers only)
- With analytics services for aggregated app improvement metrics
- If required by law or to protect our legal rights

**9. Your Rights**

You have the right to:
- Access all your personal data within the App
- Export your journal entries and progress data
- Delete all your data permanently
- Opt out of analytics collection
- Cancel your subscription at any time

**10. Children's Privacy**

Dream Travel Planner is rated 4+ and contains no restricted content. However, the App is designed for adult women planning solo travel. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us.

**11. International Users**

Your data is stored locally on your device. If you use iCloud backup, Apple's data storage policies apply. We are based in Sweden and comply with GDPR requirements.

**12. Changes to This Policy**

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes through the App.

**13. Contact Us**

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact us at the email address provided below.
legal.termsOfService:
**1. Acceptance of Terms**

By downloading, installing, or using Dream Travel Planner ("the App"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.

**2. Description of Service**

Dream Travel Planner is an AI-powered solo travel coaching application designed to help women overcome barriers to solo travel through personalized nudges, journaling, and progress tracking. The App guides users through a 5-phase journey from dreaming about travel to actually booking and going on their trip.

**3. Subscription and Payments**

*Free Trial:*
- New users receive a 14-day free trial with full access to all features
- No credit card is required to start the trial
- You can cancel anytime during the trial without charge

*Subscription Access:*
- After the trial period, a subscription is required to access the App's features
- The App uses a "hard paywall" — core features are only available to subscribers
- Subscriptions are billed through Apple's App Store
- Prices may vary by region and are displayed before purchase

*Billing:*
- Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings
- No refunds are provided for partial subscription periods

**4. User Accounts**

- You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of any account credentials
- You must provide accurate information when creating an account
- You are responsible for all activities under your account

**5. Acceptable Use**

You agree NOT to:
- Use the App for any illegal purpose
- Attempt to reverse engineer, decompile, or hack the App
- Share your account credentials with others
- Use the App in any way that could harm or impair its operation
- Violate any applicable laws or regulations

**6. Travel and Health Disclaimer**

**IMPORTANT:** Dream Travel Planner is a coaching and planning tool, NOT a professional travel advisory or mental health service.

- The App does not provide professional travel advice, safety assessments, or medical/psychological treatment
- AI-generated nudges and insights are for motivational and organizational purposes only
- Always consult official travel advisories, local authorities, and qualified professionals for travel safety decisions
- If you are experiencing anxiety, depression, or other mental health concerns, please consult a qualified healthcare professional
- We are not responsible for any travel decisions you make based on App content
- Solo travel involves inherent risks — always prioritize your personal safety

**7. Journal Content**

- You retain ownership of all journal entries, photos, and personal content you create
- Your content is stored locally on your device and processed by on-device AI
- We do not access, review, or use your personal journal content
- You are solely responsible for the content you create within the App

**8. Intellectual Property**

- The App, including its design, features, nudge content, and branding, is owned by us and protected by copyright and other intellectual property laws
- You may not copy, modify, or distribute the App or its content without permission
- The 50+ nudges and coaching content are proprietary materials

**9. Limitation of Liability**

To the maximum extent permitted by law:
- The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind
- We are not liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages
- We are not liable for any travel-related incidents, injuries, or losses
- Our total liability shall not exceed the amount you paid for the App in the past 12 months

**10. Indemnification**

You agree to indemnify and hold us harmless from any claims, damages, or expenses arising from your use of the App, your travel activities, or your violation of these Terms.

**11. Termination**

- You may stop using the App and cancel your subscription at any time
- We may suspend or terminate your access for violation of these Terms
- Upon termination, your right to use the App ceases immediately

**12. Changes to Terms**

For questions about these Terms, please contact us at the email address provided below.
